headword: {公認会計士|こうにんかいけいし}

definitions.explanation: A nationally licensed accounting professional in Japan who is authorized to perform audits, provide tax services, and offer financial consulting. One of the most prestigious professional qualifications in Japan.

examples.japanese: {公認会計士|こうにんかいけいし}の{試験|しけん}に{合格|ごうかく}した。
{公認会計士|こうにんかいけいし}に{決算|けっさん}の{監査|かんさ}を{依頼|いらい}した。
examples.english: We asked a certified public accountant to audit the financial statements.

examples.japanese: {公認会計士|こうにんかいけいし}は{日本|にほん}で{最|もっと}も{難|むずか}しい{国家資格|こっかしかく}の{一|ひと}つとされている。
examples.english: The CPA qualification is considered one of the most difficult national certifications in Japan.

notes:
Composed of {公認|こうにん} (officially certified) + {会計|かいけい} (accounting) + {士|し} (professional, specialist). The Japanese CPA certification is considered one of the three most difficult national examinations, alongside the bar exam ({司法試験|しほうしけん}) and the medical exam.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公認会計士|こうにんかいけいし}{試験|しけん}: CPA exam
- {公認会計士|こうにんかいけいし}に{依頼|いらい}する: to hire a CPA
- {公認会計士|こうにんかいけいし}の{資格|しかく}: CPA qualification
- {公認会計士|こうにんかいけいし}{事務所|じむしょ}: CPA office / accounting firm

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {税理士|ぜいりし}: tax accountant — specializes in tax filing and advice; a separate qualification from CPA
- {会計士|かいけいし}: accountant — a general term; without {公認|こうにん}, it does not imply the national certification
- {監査法人|かんさほうじん}: audit firm — an organization of CPAs that performs corporate audits
